positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led the migration of enrichment services from HPCC Systems to a modern AWS serverless platform by converting legacy ECL logic into
Python-based AWS Lambda functions, delivering scalable and resilient cloud-native data processing.
• Designed and implemented a serverless Re-Enrichment API using Amazon API Gateway, API Keys, Usage Plans, Request Validation, Velocity
Templates, and a custom Lambda Authorizer to securely orchestrate enterprise document reprocessing.
• Developed Python-based AWS Lambda services to validate PCT/PCSI/object payloads, invoke Data Lake republish workflows, and route
asynchronous reprocessing requests through Amazon SQS and AWS Step Functions.
• Designed scalable event-driven workflows using AWS Lambda, Step Functions, Amazon S3, S3 File Systems, SQS, IAM, and API Gateway to
automate XML/JSON document processing and enterprise API integrations.
• Implemented Amazon DynamoDB for authorization, request mapping, request auditing, and TTL-based lifecycle management; securely
retrieved credentials using AWS Secrets Manager.
• Built and maintained Jenkins CI/CD pipelines and JSON-based AWS CloudFormation templates to automate multi-environment
infrastructure provisioning and deployments.
• Configured and managed Amazon S3 buckets and Amazon S3 File Systems for secure storage, schema management, cached file retrieval,
and high-performance document processing.
• Supported production operations using Amazon CloudWatch, CloudWatch Logs, Lambda Aliases, monitoring, troubleshooting, and release
management across multiple environments.
• Collaborated with architects, product owners, and business stakeholders to modernize legacy enrichment services and deliver secure,
scalable cloud-native solutions.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · REST APIs · AWS Lambda · Dynamo · Amazon SQS · Amazon S3 · Jenkins · Serverless Framework · AWS CloudFormation · Amazon CloudWatch · Python (Programming Language) · Postman API

positions.title: Data Management Supervisor - PMO
positions.description:
A Supervisor role directly reporting to the VP of IT and was responsible for supporting all aspects of implementing and maturing the data management capabilities of Safe-Guard Product International. Responsible for validating data sources, extracting data applications of transformation logic, uploading data in target tables, ETL designing/testing/troubleshooting the company's data storage system before it goes live. Create, maintain and promote data management standards, checklists and guidelines.

What I do:
• Data modelling and ELT using Snowflake SQL, implementing complex stored procedures.
• Design, implement, automate and maintain large scale enterprise data ETL processes.
• Write TSQL scripts, stored procedures, user-defined functions, views, indexes per business requirements.
• Ensure that Data and Business rules are thoroughly documented and distributed across the stakeholders maintaining currency. Work with raw & aggregated data sets collected from various products across company.
• Utilize a variety of software applications, programs, and tools to accomplish assignments & responsibilities, including Microsoft Office, SQL-based databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and other Data Warehousing products like SSIS / SSAS / SSRS, ETL, MS Excel (Power View / PowerPivot / Power Query), Tableau, PowerBI, Looker, etc.
• Ownership of monitoring mission critical data processing alerts and reports, research discrepancies and resolve exceptions in timely manner.
positions.insights: Skills: Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Oracle SQL Developer · PL/SQL · SQL Server Management Studio · Looker · Tableau · Microsoft Power BI · SSRS · Microsoft SQL Server · SSIS · SQL

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
It was an exciting opportunity, to utilize my knowledge of object oriented programming to work on big data solutions within an elite team of technologists at LexisNexis. As a Software Engineer, I work with PetaBytes of complex datasets containing billions of records. I'm working on the design and implementation of big data solutions (using HPCC Systems Platform) enterprise wide, also having the opportunity to be involved in gap analyses of the business needs and identifying functional requirements. Also responsible for developing, troubleshooting, and maintaining SQL Server and ORACLE stored procedures and SSIS/ETL processes. I work with some of the latest Microsoft Technologies such as SQL Server 2012, Power Pivot, Power Query, etc. 

What I do:
Communicate and collaborate effectively on assignments with both technical and nontechnical staff.
Provide expertise in designing and implementing big data analytic capabilities.
Perform data analysis, data model design, data linking, implementation, testing, debugging, documenting, and maintenance of several applications.
Contribute to design sessions, quality testing, and code reviews.
Part of a BI team developing projects using the following technical skills:
	SQL/ORACLE Server– write and analyze SQL querying and T-SQL skills.
	Data warehousing – Dimensional modeling (Kimball) skills.
	Database design and modeling - understand and analyze complex OLTP databases with 3rd normal form database design and Dimensional data models.
	SSIS - ETL (SSIS) skills to load data from multiple sources, into data warehouses. 
	SSAS – Cube building and MDX.
	SSRS - Basic exposure to SSRS.
	HPCC Systems – Basic knowledge on Thor (the Data Refinery Cluster) which is responsible for consuming vast amounts of data, transforming, linking and indexing that data. It functions as a distributed file system with parallel processing power spread across the nodes.
positions.insights: Skills: HPCC · High Performance Computing (HPC) · Unix · SSRS · ETL · SSIS · SSAS

projects.title: Home InsurQuote BI Project
projects.description:
Provides the solutions to report benchmarking among company competitors.
• Analyze the dataset and create a dimensional data model.
• Develop the Data-Mart using SQL Server and import data (using SSIS).
• Build & deploy the cube (using SSAS).
• Conduct multidimensional analysis based on business need, and write queries, build reports, or    develop dashboards to deliver the results to business users. (using SSRS, SC Analyzer & MS PowerPivot charts)

projects.title: Developed e-commerce website
projects.description:
Website had catalog page with the description of the merchandise, an order form, a picking ticket generator, access database PHP functions, did select, update, delete, and insert of data.

• Displayed pictures of merchandise on WebPages with description,
• Used table tag to list price and shipping weight of the merchandise,
• Created CSS template to have uniform styling of web pages,
• Used div tag to have a separate section in an HTML page,
• Generate button to show alert box,
• Used console.log () to check for errors, see the variables used in JavaScript (), get to know the line at which error was caused at,
• Created HTML form which generates a picking ticket when submit button is clicked,
• Created HTML form which would take customer information and used a drop down to display states from the database. User would choose the payment method, and store this information in database.
